_about: Gen Bench (docs/bench.md): fixed briefs that cover every kind of output, run through the app's real path and scored with src/quality. Change a brief only with a new `version`: scores are compared across runs of the same brief version. `via` is the app path (a scene kind's AI, or make.checked); `kind` is what is scored; `cast` names characters below whose references identity is scored against; `plan` is the rough work for the price estimate (src/estimate.ts), not what the AI must do.

style.frost: Cold blue-white palette with amber practical lights, soft volumetric haze, anamorphic lens, filmic grain, grounded sci-fi like a 1970s production design.
style.storybook: Painterly children's-book illustration, warm gouache textures, soft edges, muted greens and ochres.

cast.name: Maya Okafor
cast.description: A woman in her early thirties, a smuggler pilot: dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair with a shaved left side, a thin scar through her right eyebrow, amber eyes. She wears a worn rust-orange flight jacket with a fur collar over a grey thermal shirt, fingerless gloves.

cast.name: Brann Holt
cast.description: A broad man in his sixties, a ship's mechanic: weathered pale skin, a bushy white beard, bald head, small round goggles pushed up on his forehead, a heavy grease-stained canvas apron over a green wool sweater.

cast.name: Iko
cast.description: A twelve-year-old courier: light brown skin, a mop of curly black hair, big curious eyes, a yellow raincoat two sizes too big and a battered red messenger bag across the chest.

cast.name: Captain Vell
cast.description: A tall, gaunt woman in her fifties, a customs officer: pale skin, silver hair in a severe bun, sharp cheekbones, thin lips, an immaculate navy greatcoat with a high collar and a single silver badge.

briefs.title: Character sheet
briefs.brief: A character sheet of Maya Okafor: front, three-quarter and back views, full body, standing in a neutral pose on a plain light grey background, empty hands.

briefs.title: Character sheet (older man)
briefs.brief: A character sheet of Brann Holt: front, three-quarter and back views, full body, neutral pose on a plain light grey background, empty hands.

briefs.title: Expressions
briefs.brief: Four head-and-shoulders portraits of Iko side by side: laughing, scared, angry and sleepy, the same yellow raincoat in each.

briefs.title: Talking close-up
briefs.brief: A close-up of Maya Okafor in a dim cockpit lit by amber dials, looking straight at the camera and saying: "We land in ten minutes, and nobody talks to customs but me."

briefs.title: Two-person argument, 5 shots
briefs.brief: A two-person argument in five shots at a frozen landing pad at night: a wide shot of Maya Okafor and Captain Vell facing each other under floodlights; over Vell's shoulder onto Maya, who says "The manifest is clean."; the reverse onto Vell, who says "Then you won't mind if I open the crates."; a close-up of Maya clenching her jaw; a wide shot as Vell walks past her toward the ship.

briefs.title: Poster
briefs.brief: A vertical film poster: Maya Okafor in front with Brann Holt behind her shoulder, a battered cargo ship over a frozen moon in the background, and the title "COLD RUN" in large clean capitals at the bottom.

briefs.title: Skybox
briefs.brief: A 360 degree panorama of a frozen moon's surface at dusk: ice ridges to the horizon, a ringed gas giant low in the sky, two small suns setting.

briefs.title: Prop (3D)
briefs.brief: A 3D model of a brass storm lantern with a cracked glass chimney and a wire handle, game-ready.

briefs.title: Rigged character (3D)
briefs.brief: A rigged 3D model of Brann Holt in an A-pose, ready to animate, with his apron and goggles.

briefs.title: 30-second trailer
briefs.brief: A 30-second trailer for a show called "Cold Run": a cargo ship landing on a frozen moon, Brann Holt welding in the hold, Captain Vell's patrol lights sweeping the ice, Maya Okafor running across the landing pad, a chase through an ice canyon, and the title card "COLD RUN" at the end. Music that builds, cut to the beat.

briefs.title: 3 shots, one recurring prop
briefs.brief: Three shots in a rainy market: Iko finds a glowing blue egg in a crate; Iko hides the same glowing blue egg inside the red messenger bag; Iko runs through the crowd clutching the bag with the egg's glow showing through it.

briefs.title: Character walking
briefs.brief: A tracking shot of Captain Vell walking briskly down a steel corridor toward the camera, greatcoat swinging, fluorescent lights passing overhead.

briefs.title: Establishing shot
briefs.brief: A slow aerial push-in over a small mining town of domes on a frozen moon at night, windows glowing amber, snow blowing across the rooftops.

briefs.title: Product still
briefs.brief: A studio product photo of a matte black wireless headphone on a white pedestal, soft shadow, a single sprig of eucalyptus beside it.

briefs.title: Readable text
briefs.brief: A weathered metal sign bolted to an ice wall that reads exactly "DOCK 7 - NO CUSTOMS BEYOND THIS POINT", lit by one amber lamp.

briefs.title: Hands
briefs.brief: A close-up of Brann Holt's two hands repairing a small engine part with a screwdriver, all ten fingers visible, workbench lamp light.

briefs.title: Group of four
briefs.brief: All four standing in a row in a hangar, full body: Maya Okafor, Brann Holt, Iko and Captain Vell, each recognisable, Vell standing slightly apart with her arms folded.

briefs.title: Tileable texture
briefs.brief: A seamless tileable texture of cracked blue glacier ice with trapped air bubbles, top-down, even lighting.

briefs.title: Time of day
briefs.brief: Iko standing on a rooftop at night under a full moon, holding a paper lantern, the city lights below.

briefs.title: Fast action
briefs.brief: Maya Okafor vaults over a stack of cargo crates and lands in a crouch, snow kicking up around her, handheld camera.

briefs.title: Continuing a shot
briefs.brief: Iko opens a wooden door and steps into a warm bakery; then, continuing the same shot, Iko walks to the counter and rings the little bell.

briefs.title: Creature design
briefs.brief: A creature design: a six-legged ice beetle the size of a dog, translucent blue shell with frost patterns, shown from the side on a plain background.

briefs.title: Set piece (3D)
briefs.brief: A 3D model of a small cargo crate with stencilled markings and metal corner guards, game-ready.

briefs.title: Voice line
briefs.brief: Captain Vell, cold and measured, says: "Every crate. Every bolt. I have all night."

briefs.title: Two voices
briefs.brief: A short exchange: Maya says "Is she going to hold together?" and Brann answers, gruff and fond, "She always does, if you stop kicking her."

briefs.title: Sound effect
briefs.brief: A heavy airlock door hissing open, then a metallic clunk as it locks.

briefs.title: Ambience
briefs.brief: Thirty seconds of wind across an ice field at night, with distant creaking ice and no music.

briefs.title: Theme music
briefs.brief: A 30-second main theme for "Cold Run": a lonely synth melody over a slow, building drum pulse, ending on a held chord.

briefs.title: Same look, new subject
briefs.brief: A fox in a knitted scarf reading a newspaper on a park bench in autumn.

briefs.title: Episode thumbnail
briefs.brief: A 16:9 episode thumbnail: Maya Okafor's face large on the left looking worried, a burning cargo ship on the right, and the words "EPISODE 2" in bold.
